activation: Proof of official diagonal-crossing authorization for this location and person-afoot route, independent of ordinary crosswalk permission.
controlled_cases: Same route, actor, authorized diagonal movement and post-entry instruction sequence. Change only the governing diagonal-entry instruction at first road entry, with source evidence of what each instruction prescribes.
exact_clause: Except as provided in NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B]: When authorized to cross diagonally, pedestrians shall cross only in accordance with the official traffic-control devices pertaining to such crossing movements.
exception: NRS 484B.290 bracketed to LVMC-11-30-140-B is unresolved for this witness. Separate evidence of white-cane, blindness or assistance context and its applicability is required; no such evidence appears in the current membership or witness.
governing_instruction: Bind the official device identity and its movement applicability to the pedestrian path; save its actual instruction at first road entry and the complete time sequence thereafter.
proof_status: source review only; no Native, offline, compatibility, saved Core/video or independent delivery audit proof
rejected_inference: A phase change after entry alone does not prove a pedestrian violated this clause; do not replace actual device instructions with a guessed all-way phase rule.

source_observation_mapping.dev.pedestrian_signal: original device state and instruction history
source_observation_mapping.dev.regulatory_sign: original sign or authorization source, when applicable
source_observation_mapping.kin.time: synchronized entry and subsequent device timestamps
source_observation_mapping.rel.occupies: body footprint against authorized diagonal path
source_observation_mapping.ru.subject: saved actor identity and person-afoot track
